for your business? We offer a full range of buses, vans, and trucks to keep your operations running

keep you going.

## Who Is THOR?

In 1980, we embarked on a journey to connect people with nature, and families with each other.
Today, we continue that journey by leading a global family of companies that make it easier and more
enjoyable for families of all types to create lasting outdoor memories. Together we can Go
Everywhere; Stay Anywhere.

Together, the THOR family of companies represents the world’s largest manufacturer of recreational
vehicles. We offer a comprehensive range of RVs and travel tools to inspire and empower everyone to
Go Everywhere. Stay Anywhere. We’ve chosen our family wisely so your choice is that much easier.

## EXPLORE RV TYPES

### We’ll help you figure out what kind of RV is right for you.

[View All ][46]
[
[A venture stratus parked next to a river with a sunset ]

### Travel Trailer

Travel trailers are the most popular type of non-motorized RV. They can be towed by a variety of
vehicles and are made for a variety of uses, from hauling to vacationing to full-time RVing.

Learn More
][47]
[
[a group of friends with a fifth wheel RV boondocking in a field ]

### Toy Hauler

Many people think of toy haulers as the wild-child of the RV world, but these RVs have multi-purpose
utlitity for every adventurer. The open "garage" can serve as storage for toys, an extra bedroom or
even an on-the-go office.

Learn More
][48]
[
[A Keystone Sprinter fifth wheel in a field in front of mountains ]

### Fifth Wheel

Easy to hitch, easy to tow, and stable, fifth wheels offer plenty of comfort for the whole family.
Versatility and space are the reasons why RVers choose fifth wheels for their trips — or for their
full-time homes.

Learn More
][49]
[
[A Tiffin Allegro Red Class A motorhome parked in a field next to a rocky cliffside.]

### Class A Motorhome

Built with the same framing and construction as commercial trucks and buses, Class A motorhomes are
some of the largest vehicles on the road. AKA lots of room to stretch out and get comfortable.

Learn More
][50]
[
[A woman laying in the bed of an Airstream rangeline camper van with the doors open reading a book]

### Class B Camper Van

Small, streamlined and ready to roll. Class B motorhomes (also known as camper vans) offer luxurious
living space best suited for small groups.

Learn More
][51]
[
[A group of young people singing around a campfire in front of a Thor Motor Coach Magnitude]

### Class C Motorhome

Recognizable by their raised sleeping or storage areas which extend over the cab of the RV, Class C
Motorhomes offer more living space than Class B Motorhomes but are smaller in size and can offer
better gas mileage than Class A Motorcoaches.

Learn More
][52]

## EXPLORE RV TYPES

### We’ll help you figure out what kind of RV is right for you.

[View All ][46]
[
[A venture stratus parked next to a river with a sunset ]

### Travel Trailer

Travel trailers are the most popular type of non-motorized RV. They can be towed by a variety of
vehicles and are made for a variety of uses, from hauling to vacationing to full-time RVing.

Learn More
][47]
[
[a group of friends with a fifth wheel RV boondocking in a field ]

### Toy Hauler

Many people think of toy haulers as the wild-child of the RV world, but these RVs have multi-purpose
utlitity for every adventurer. The open "garage" can serve as storage for toys, an extra bedroom or
even an on-the-go office.

Learn More
][48]
[
[A Keystone Sprinter fifth wheel in a field in front of mountains ]

### Fifth Wheel

Easy to hitch, easy to tow, and stable, fifth wheels offer plenty of comfort for the whole family.
Versatility and space are the reasons why RVers choose fifth wheels for their trips — or for their
full-time homes.

Learn More
][49]
[
[A Tiffin Allegro Red Class A motorhome parked in a field next to a rocky cliffside.]

### Class A Motorhome

Built with the same framing and construction as commercial trucks and buses, Class A motorhomes are
some of the largest vehicles on the road. AKA lots of room to stretch out and get comfortable.

Learn More
][50]
[
[A woman laying in the bed of an Airstream rangeline camper van with the doors open reading a book]

### Class B Camper Van

Small, streamlined and ready to roll. Class B motorhomes (also known as camper vans) offer luxurious
living space best suited for small groups.

Learn More
][51]
[
[A group of young people singing around a campfire in front of a Thor Motor Coach Magnitude]

### Class C Motorhome

Recognizable by their raised sleeping or storage areas which extend over the cab of the RV, Class C
Motorhomes offer more living space than Class B Motorhomes but are smaller in size and can offer
better gas mileage than Class A Motorcoaches.

Learn More
][52]

## Design, style, innovation

Alfatherm è una società leader nella produzione di film e laminati termoplastici utilizzati in
svariati settori quali decorazione delle superfici per arredamento e interior design, film per il
settore dell’arte grafica, capsule ed etichette.
* **Dal 1963 –** Alfatherm è un produttore internazionale di film in PVC
* **Ricerca e sviluppo** – Innovazione costante e attenzione ai nuovi trend del mercato
* **Sostenibilità –** Alfatherm conferma costantemente il suo impegno per l’ambiente

La costante spinta all’innovazione ha portato Alfatherm tra i leader mondiali nel settore della
decorazione delle superfici per arredamento. L’azienda è oggi un punto di riferimento per i maggiori
produttori mondiali di pannelli decorativi grazie alle superfici super opache a elevatissima
resistenza al graffio e alle macchie e all’esclusiva goffratura a registro che consente di
realizzare superfici decorate difficilmente distinguibili dal legno.

[Chi Siamo][24]

## I nostri prodotti

### Surface Decoration

Film e laminati termoplastici
per arredamento e interior design

### Visual Communication

Film adesivi per visual advertising, protezione, decorazione, labelling

### Capsule & Sleeves

Film termoretraibili
per capsule e sleeves

### Cartotecnica

Film e foglie per stampa serigrafica
e saldatura ad alta frequenza

### Imballaggio

Film termoformabili per imballaggio

### Medicale

## Sostenibilità

Alfatherm conferma costantemente il suo impegno per l’ambiente con un investimento continuo e
rilevante in termini di riduzione dell’impatto delle produzioni e con scelte coerenti in termini di
compatibilità ambientale dei prodotti, delle tecnologie e delle metodologie produttive.

Alfatherm è associata a [VinylPlus®][25], l’organizzazione creata dall’industria europea del PVC
(produzione e trasformazione) per vincere la sfida dello sviluppo sostenibile, migliorando i
processi di produzione e i prodotti, minimizzando le emissioni e i rifiuti e dando impulso a
raccolta e riciclo di manufatti a fine vita.

Alfatherm è associata a [PVC Forum Italia][26], l’associazione italiana che riunisce le principali
aziende della filiera italiana del PVC e promuove la sostenibilità dei prodotti e delle applicazioni
in PVC.

***Alfatherm è associato:***

      

### Impegno costante per la salvaguardia dell’ambiente

## Pensando al futuro

Negli ultimi anni un forte sviluppo tecnologico, dovuto a consistenti investimenti, ha permesso di
affrontare le nuove sfide del mercato che richiedono costanti novità, quali, nuovi disegni, nuove
superfici, nuovi colori.

## Design, style, innovation

Alfatherm è una società leader nella produzione di film e laminati termoplastici utilizzati in
svariati settori quali decorazione delle superfici per arredamento e interior design, film per il
settore dell’arte grafica, capsule ed etichette.
* **Dal 1963 –** Alfatherm è un produttore internazionale di film in PVC
* **Ricerca e sviluppo** – Innovazione costante e attenzione ai nuovi trend del mercato
* **Sostenibilità –** Alfatherm conferma costantemente il suo impegno per l’ambiente

La costante spinta all’innovazione ha portato Alfatherm tra i leader mondiali nel settore della
decorazione delle superfici per arredamento. L’azienda è oggi un punto di riferimento per i maggiori
produttori mondiali di pannelli decorativi grazie alle superfici super opache a elevatissima
resistenza al graffio e alle macchie e all’esclusiva goffratura a registro che consente di
realizzare superfici decorate difficilmente distinguibili dal legno.

[Chi Siamo][24]

## I nostri prodotti

### Surface Decoration

Film e laminati termoplastici
per arredamento e interior design

### Visual Communication

Film adesivi per visual advertising, protezione, decorazione, labelling

### Capsule & Sleeves

Film termoretraibili
per capsule e sleeves

### Cartotecnica

Film e foglie per stampa serigrafica
e saldatura ad alta frequenza

### Imballaggio

Film termoformabili per imballaggio

### Medicale

## Sostenibilità

Alfatherm conferma costantemente il suo impegno per l’ambiente con un investimento continuo e
rilevante in termini di riduzione dell’impatto delle produzioni e con scelte coerenti in termini di
compatibilità ambientale dei prodotti, delle tecnologie e delle metodologie produttive.

Alfatherm è associata a [VinylPlus®][25], l’organizzazione creata dall’industria europea del PVC
(produzione e trasformazione) per vincere la sfida dello sviluppo sostenibile, migliorando i
processi di produzione e i prodotti, minimizzando le emissioni e i rifiuti e dando impulso a
raccolta e riciclo di manufatti a fine vita.

Alfatherm è associata a [PVC Forum Italia][26], l’associazione italiana che riunisce le principali
aziende della filiera italiana del PVC e promuove la sostenibilità dei prodotti e delle applicazioni
in PVC.

***Alfatherm è associato:***

      

### Impegno costante per la salvaguardia dell’ambiente

## Pensando al futuro

Negli ultimi anni un forte sviluppo tecnologico, dovuto a consistenti investimenti, ha permesso di
affrontare le nuove sfide del mercato che richiedono costanti novità, quali, nuovi disegni, nuove
superfici, nuovi colori.

### Eberspächer climate control systems

## The right temperature for every requirement

Effective vehicle air conditioning by Eberspächer climate control solutions comprises heating and
cooling components, as well as intelligent control elements. These are requirements for which we
provide efficient solutions, independent of the engine and in mobile applications as well. From
passenger cars to special-purpose vehicles: We are your partner for climate control solutions such
as OEM and retrofit heating or air conditioning systems.

### Frequently asked questions

### What is GeoGuessr?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is a geography game, in which you are dropped somewhere in the world in a street view
panorama and your mission is to find clues and guess your location on the world map.

### I have trouble accessing my account.

[Show]
If you've forgot your password, click on "Already have an account?" in the upper right corner, and
then on "Forgot your password?". Enter the email address which is connected to your account, and
we'll send you an email with a link to reset your password! Don't forget to check you spam email if
it may have gotten caught there.
If you are not receiving an email you might have enabled Google/Facebook login. If so, send an email
to [our support team][15] and we will help you further. If you've forgotten which email you signed
up with, no worries! Contact us at [our support team][16] and we'll help you out!

### Is GeoGuessr available on App Store and Google Play?

[Show]
Yes, GeoGuessr is available on iOS and Android, and your account lets you play on the app as well.

### What languages is GeoGuessr available in?

[Show]
GeoGuessr is available in 11 different languages. You can select language in the website footer
under "Change language".

### What is Seterra?

[Show]
Become a geography expert and have fun at the same time! Seterra is an entertaining and educational
geography game that gives you access to over 400 customizable quizzes. Seterra will challenge you
with quizzes about countries, capitals, flags, oceans, lakes and more!
[
Play Seterra now!
][17]

###### Mobile RV Repair in Winder, GA

Welcome to Georgia RV Repair, your trusted partner for all your RV repair needs. We are proud to be
a Veteran, family-owned and operated business, based out Barrow County in Winder, Georgia dedicated
to providing exceptional service to RV and boating enthusiasts like you.


At Georgia RV Repair, we understand the value of your recreational vehicle and the memories it
holds. Our passion for RVs, and our commitment to quality craftsmanship drive us to deliver
unparalleled repair services tailored to meet your specific needs.


Our team of highly skilled technicians is at the heart of our success. With their extensive
knowledge and expertise, we are capable of diagnosing and resolving a wide range of RV issues, from
mechanical and electrical problems to preventative maintenance. We stay up-to-date with the latest
industry advancements and utilize state-of-the-art equipment to ensure your RV is back on the road
in pristine condition.

 

We take pride in our personalized approach to customer service. When you choose Georgia RV Repair,
you can expect open communication, transparency, and a friendly atmosphere. We take the time to
listen to your concerns, provide honest assessments, and offer cost-effective solutions that fit
your budget. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we strive to exceed your expectations with
every interaction.


As a family business, we understand the importance of trust and reliability. When you choose us, you
become part of our extended family. We treat your RV with the care and attention it deserves, as if
it were our own. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond repairs. We are committed to building
long-lasting relationships with our customers by providing ongoing support and guidance. Whether you
need routine maintenance, pre-trip inspections, or expert advice on upgrading your RV, we are here
to assist you every step of the way.

 

We invite you to experience the personalized service and exceptional craftsmanship that sets us
apart. Contact us today to schedule an appointment or to discuss your RV repair needs. Let our
family take care of yours, and together, we'll keep your RV running smoothly for all your adventures
on the road.



Call us or fill out our [service request form][16] today!

Welcome to Georgia RV Repair, your trusted partner for all your RV repair needs. We are proud to be

every interaction.

become part of our extended family. We treat your RV with the care and attention it deserves, as if
it were our own. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond repairs. We are committed to building
long-lasting relationships with our customers by providing ongoing support and guidance. Whether you
need routine maintenance, pre-trip inspections, or expert advice on upgrading your RV, we are here
to assist you every step of the way.

 

We invite you to experience the personalized service and exceptional craftsmanship that sets us

on the road.

In 2026, as America celebrates its 250th birthday, we are invited to do more than remember
history—we are invited to live it. How are you living your life today? How much do you enjoy your
liberty? And what does your pursuit of happiness look like?

This historic year offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience America the way it was
meant to be seen—mile by mile, state by state, from sea to shining sea. By joining Horizon Transport
and delivering RVs and commercial vehicles during the America250 celebration, you’ll travel through
the heart of the nation as all 50 states mark this milestone in their own colorful and unforgettable
ways.

# Flatbed

Horizon Transport’s Flatbed division is our elite division. Flatbed drivers invest in larger trucks
and flatbed trailers. They use these trailers to haul multiple RVs and other vehicles or trailers
across North America. The Flatbed drivers at Horizon also have greater income potential as they get
paid more per mile and have many reload opportunities.

[Learn more][21]
[horizon flatbed]

# Tow-Away

Horizon Transport’s Tow-Away division is one of the largest in the country. In Tow-Away, drivers use
their pickup trucks to pull RVs and other trailers across the country, one at a time. This is our
most popular division as over 80% of RVs built are 5th-wheel or bumper-pull.

[Learn more][22]

# Drive-Away

Drive-Away is unique in that you don’t need a truck. You simply get in the RV, UPS truck, or other
large vehicle and drive it to the destination. Having a Tow-car can be very helpful, but it’s not
required. Using our app to self-dispatch can make make the Drive-Away division a fun and profitable
adventure.

[Learn more][23]

# Flatbed

Horizon Transport’s Flatbed division is our elite division. Flatbed drivers invest in larger trucks
and flatbed trailers. They use these trailers to haul multiple RVs and other vehicles or trailers
across North America. The Flatbed drivers at Horizon also have greater income potential as they get
paid more per mile and have many reload opportunities.

# Tow-Away

Horizon Transport’s Tow-Away division is one of the largest in the country. In Tow-Away, drivers use

most popular division as over 80% of RVs built are 5th-wheel or bumper-pull.

[Learn more][22]

# Drive-Away

Drive-Away is unique in that you don’t need a truck. You simply get in the RV, UPS truck, or other
large vehicle and drive it to the destination. Having a Tow-car can be very helpful, but it’s not
required. Using our app to self-dispatch can make make the Drive-Away division a fun and profitable
adventure.

## Opening Windows of Opportunity since 1972.

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Long and Tullier, Inc. is a professional, multiple-line field sales firm (Manufacturer’s           
Representative) whose core focus is selling parts and accessories to the Recreational Vehicle and  
Manufactured Housing Aftermarket Industry through two-step distribution. Successfully representing 
quality suppliers since 1972. We are involved primarily at the After Market level of the RV/MH     
industries. If you need help selling a product or are looking to buy a product we sell, then       
contact Long and Tullier, Inc. and allow us to help you succeed.                                   
*No matter the application or product, Long and Tullier's distribution network has you covered!*   
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Invest in your company’s future today! Start solving your business needs now by calling us at **
**(770) 424-0711 or contacting us online to discuss how Long and Tullier, Inc. can *“open windows of
opportunity”* in the Recreational Vehicle and Manufactured Housing aftermarket industries. Let us
handle your outside sales responsibilities!**

## Creating Value, Driving Results

MainStream Management is a full service consulting firm specializing in [operational
improvement][91], [turnaround and financial restructuring][92], and [transaction services][93] for
mid-market public and private corporations world wide.



We are a different kind of consulting company. We possess:
* Extensive capital markets experience
* An exemplary track record in creating value for our clients
* Experience as owners and operators of middle market business enterprises


MainStream Management specializes in providing corporate renewal and financial restructuring,
operational improvement, and transaction services for middle market, privately held companies and
publicly traded companies. [Read More][94]

### Double Wide

Today’s doublewide manufactured homes offer generous floor plans, modern layouts, and high-end
features that rival traditional site-built houses. With open-concept kitchens, large bedrooms, and

[Used]

### Used

Buying a used manufactured home can be a smart choice, but it’s important to check the age of the
home first. Homes built before 1976 were not held to the same safety and construction standards.
That year, the HUD code was introduced, setting strict federal guidelines for manufactured housing.
Since then, these homes have seen major improvements in quality, safety, and design — and the term
“manufactured home” officially replaced “mobile home.”

# Now Offering Modular Homes – More Options, More Freedom
* Looking for the perfect balance of style, strength, and savings? We now offer modular homes
  alongside our lineup of high-quality manufactured homes, giving you more ways to own a home that
  fits your lifestyle and your budget.
* **Modular homes** are built to the same codes as site-built homes and often follow similar market
  trends. Known for their durability and long-term value, they’re a great option for buyers who want
  a permanent foundation and the feel of a traditional house.
* **Manufactured homes**, on the other hand, offer unbeatable affordability and flexibility. Built
  in climate-controlled facilities and set up quickly on-site, they can save you thousands in
  upfront costs. Depending on how they’re installed — with or without a permanent foundation — you
  can control how much you invest long term.
  Whether you’re looking for affordable housing, energy-efficient design, or a permanent residence,
  we’ll help you compare the benefits of modular vs. manufactured homes so you can choose the right
  fit for your future.

# Mobile or Modular Home

[Sinlge Wide]

### Sinlge Wide

Purchasing a manufactured home is significantly more affordable than a traditional concrete-built
house and offers quicker setup once the home is completed. These homes are built for comfort,
efficiency, and long-term value. With flexible floor plans, customizable features, and lower
maintenance needs, manufactured homes offer a practical solution for today’s homeowners who want
more freedom and less financial strain.
[Double Wide]

### Double Wide

Today’s doublewide manufactured homes offer generous floor plans, modern layouts, and high-end
features that rival traditional site-built houses. With open-concept kitchens, large bedrooms, and
upgraded finishes, these homes are designed for comfort and convenience. Doublewides are typically
built to stay in place, but they still offer more flexibility than traditional homes when it comes
to relocation. They also use the same quality building materials found in many standard homes. The
real cost savings come from efficient construction processes, not inferior materials. If you’re
looking for space, style, and smart value, a doublewide manufactured home delivers on all fronts.
[Used]

### Used

Buying a used manufactured home can be a smart choice, but it’s important to check the age of the
home first. Homes built before 1976 were not held to the same safety and construction standards.
That year, the HUD code was introduced, setting strict federal guidelines for manufactured housing.
Since then, these homes have seen major improvements in quality, safety, and design — and the term
“manufactured home” officially replaced “mobile home.”

# Now Offering Modular Homes – More Options, More Freedom
* Looking for the perfect balance of style, strength, and savings? We now offer modular homes
  alongside our lineup of high-quality manufactured homes, giving you more ways to own a home that
  fits your lifestyle and your budget.
* **Modular homes** are built to the same codes as site-built homes and often follow similar market
  trends. Known for their durability and long-term value, they’re a great option for buyers who want
  a permanent foundation and the feel of a traditional house.
* **Manufactured homes**, on the other hand, offer unbeatable affordability and flexibility. Built
  in climate-controlled facilities and set up quickly on-site, they can save you thousands in
  upfront costs. Depending on how they’re installed — with or without a permanent foundation — you
  can control how much you invest long term.
  Whether you’re looking for affordable housing, energy-efficient design, or a permanent residence,
  we’ll help you compare the benefits of modular vs. manufactured homes so you can choose the right
  fit for your future.

# WELCOME

Where will your next adventure take you?  Are you going for a week or the winter?  Are you
full-timing or a weekend warrior?  Whatever your situation or style, your RV is a home away from
home and deserves to be taken care of.  Connecting with family and friends is the most important
part of your trip, but it can only be done with a RV that is well maintained.  Whether you want to
settle into a deluxe RV park or go off-grid into the great outdoors, we will help keep your rig in
top condition so you can spend more time doing what you want.

# ABOUT  US

Certified and Registered RV Service Technicians

fully insured and Warranty affiliated. 

Delivering timely and professional mobile RV diagnostics, repairs and consultations to our clients.

Colossians 3:17


## WHAT OUR CLIENTS HAVE TO SAY

Todd Boteler

Thanks for everything. So relieved to have the microwave, awning, and chair buttoned up with great
workmanship!

Claude Poisson

> 10/10 Customer Service,

> Quality & Timeliness.  

Bonnie Harvey

> An absolutely pleasant experience!  Got the help we needed from one of the nicest people I've met
> lately!

> 10/10 Customer Service

> Mark was awesome!

Georgianna Maté

> 10/10 Customer Service, Quality & Timeliness.

>  Best Ever!!

Donald Tremblay

Knowledgeable, professional.  Very pleased with the service provided.

[OurRig.jpeg]

Do you want more adventure out of your experience?

Whether you have a travel trailer, 5th wheel, Class A, B, or C, 

we have the technical knowledge and skills to diagnose, repair and maintain your RV. 

The air conditioner, furnace, water heater, appliances and electrical system are the fundamental
instruments that need to  function optimally so you can travel worry free.

[NRVTA-Logo-WEB-2 (1).png]

The Recreational Vehicle Technician Association of America (RVTAA) is the certifying body and
professional membership organization providing credentials for professional recreational vehicle
technicians across North America.

[RVTAA-Logo-Transparant-Bckground-Web.png]

HOURS OF OPERATION

Sunday - Friday  9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Closed Saturday & Holidays

Emergency rates apply outside of regular business hours.

## THE TRUCK CAMPER PEOPLE SINCE 1961

At Northstar Campers, we are here to help you live the lifestyle you want, wherever you want to go.
As the “Truck Camper People,” we’ve been helping people get away for more than 60 years. The quality
of our truck campers can’t be matched! We offer hardwall and pop-up truck campers that can go
anywhere you can, allowing you to enjoy them the way you want, anywhere you want.

We are proud to be a family-owned business with a passion for helping individuals and families make
memories while they travel, camp and enjoy the great outdoors.

[polaroids]

With our experience and dedication to quality, you can rest assured that your Northstar camper will
be out on the road with you for many years to come.

## Ozat Tools: Over 50 Years of Industrial Expertise

Our socket and wrench solutions are field-tested across energy, mining, marine, and heavy
engineering sectors.

100% Industrial-Grade Quality.
With over 50 years of industry leadership since its founding in 1970, Ozat 2000 UG has established
itself as a trusted manufacturer of high-performance impact sockets, versatile striking wrenches,
and rugged construction tools.

Operating from Germany and serving global markets, Ozat tools are engineered in sizes ranging from
¼″ to 3½″ square drive, available in hexagon, spline, and custom configurations to match your
specific application.

## Explore Our Industrial-Grade Sockets, Wrenches & Accessories

Browse our full catalog of heavy-duty impact sockets and industrial wrenches, designed for
high-torque applications and engineered to meet ISO and DIN standards.

### Impact Sockets

Ozat impact sockets are engineered to handle extreme torque with superior durability. Designed for
heavy-duty use in oil & gas, mining, and construction environments, they ensure long service life
and safe performance under pressure.

[Explore all options][138]

### Impact Socket Sets

Ozat impact socket sets offer a complete solution for professional torqueing tasks. Built for
consistency and convenience, each set includes popular sizes for industrial applications in power,
mining, and oil & gas sectors.

[Explore all options][139]

### Impact Wrenches

Ozat wrenches are designed for high-impact industrial tasks, including flange bolting and structural
assembly. Available in striking, slogging, and offset types, they deliver reliable torque in tight
or heavy-duty environments.

[Explore all options][140]

### Bolting Accessories

Our bolting accessories include adapters, extension bars, lug nut sockets, torsion bars, and
universal joints. These components enhance tool versatility, making Ozat kits ideal for complex and
confined industrial bolting operations.

## REV SPECIALTY VEHICLE SEGMENTS

### FIRE APPARATUS, EMERGENCY VEHICLES, AND COMMERCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE VEHICLES

REV Group companies design and manufacture specialty vehicles including fire apparatus, emergency
vehicles and commercial infrastructure vehicles like terminal trucks and street sweepers.

E-ONE^{®}, Ferrara™, KME™, Spartan Emergency Response^{®}, Smeal™, Spartan Fire Chassis™ and Ladder
Tower™ brands each have a unique product offering and adhere to the high standards the REV Group has
set in performance and reliability. Products offered include aerials, pumpers, AARFs, rescue and
wildland apparatus.

Horton^{®}, AEV^{®}, Road Rescue^{®}, Wheeled Coach^{®} and Leader^{®} companies manufacture leading
Type I, Type II, Type III, and Medium-Duty emergency vehicles for fire departments, municipalities,
and private companies worldwide. Each ambulance is designed and built to perform and meet the needs
of communities everywhere. In addition, to prolong the life of the vehicles, there are
state-of-the-art REV Remount Centers in Jefferson, North Carolina, and Grove City, Ohio.

Commercial infrastructure vehicles like Capacity Trucks^{®} which are utilized in the busiest ports,
rail terminals, and warehouse/distribution centers throughout the world and LayMor^{®} industrial
sweepers for municipalities and contractors.

# Supporting RV Travelers and Dealerships For Nearly 20 Years

[ Learn More ][25]
[RVCare_R66_Main]

## Wherever the road takes you... You can count on us.

The ROUTE 66 RV Network has paired with RV Care in Canada to create the largest RV Dealer Network in
North America. When you purchase an RV from an ROUTE 66/RV Care dealership, you know to expect the
best. From the moment you start shopping for your next RV to the annual service after you purchase,
we make a promise to you that you will receive the best care from our dealerships. And, if you find
that you need help while traveling, rest assured knowing that one of our over 200 dealership
locations will have you covered.  

[ Read More ][26]

## Our Customer Care Promises To You

Every new or used RV purchased from a ROUTE 66 RV Network dealer comes with our exclusive Customer
Care Promises at no charge. 

10% off parts and accessories at any Route 66 RV Network Parts store in North America (not including
service, special order or on sale parts.)

While traveling, we will make every effort to diagnose your RV’s problem within one business day of
your arrival and, if possible, complete the repair or place your RV in the service schedule with a
preferred status.

We will use the Network’s Proprietary Parts Network to quickly locate and secure any parts needed
that are unique to your RV’s year, make and model.

[ VIEW ALL CUSTOMER CARE PROMISES ][27]
As an RV Club member, you can speak with a certified RV technician 24/7 for operational and
troubleshooting advice about your RV. Additionally, enjoy thousands of specially negotiated ways to
shop, travel, explore and enhance your RVing lifestyle.
[ LEARN MORE ][28]
In addition to the RV Club benefits, RV Club Unlimited members can enjoy peace of mind with the RV
industry’s best value Roadside Assistance – not only for your RV, but for every vehicle in your
household.*
[ LEARN MORE ][29]

*Some restrictions apply

## Dealer Programs & Services

As part of the ROUTE 66 commitment to customer care, we believe RV owners should only have to focus
on the journey and the destination. We have set up many different programs and services for our
dealerships that provide their customers benefits as if they were buying an RV from a national
dealership chain.

[ VIEW DEALER PROGRAMS ][30]

## Looking for an RV?

Take a look at our map by clicking the link below and find a ROUTE 66/RV Care dealership near you!
By purchasing from one of our dealerships, you are promised top-notch customer service throughout
the buying process and beyond.

## Grow your career in RV service

With 72 million Americans planning to take an RV trip in the next year, there’s** **more demand and
opportunity for skilled RV technicians than ever before. Our hands-on training and instruction
provides the experience and expertise needed to succeed in this exciting career field with
manufacturers, dealerships and repair shops nationwide.

[See your career path][40]
[Technician working on box]

## Learn from the best in the industry

The RV Technical Institute's technician training program is the RV industry’s gold standard. We
leveraged decades of industry experience and partnered with the top RV manufacturer and supplier
leaders in the field to develop the most up-to-date and influential RV technician training program
ever built. There is simply no better RV training out there.

[Discover our Gold Standard][41]
[Technician working on axel]

## Level up your career

Whether you’re looking to jumpstart a new career, change your profession, or if you're an RV owner
looking to earn supplemental income, this is an ideal time to become a trained RV technician. This
in-demand field provides the flexibility to live and work from anywhere, comprehensive salary and
benefits, and exciting career opportunities in one of the fastest growing jobs in the country. 

[Get expert training online][42]
[group of technicians working]

## Enterprise OSINT software platform

that transforms public data into actionable intelligence.
[ Discover Horizon® ][53]

### Speed

#### Investigations in seconds, not weeks.

Automate OSINT data collection and analysis across billions of public sources to dramatically reduce
investigation time. Horizon® OSINT software accelerates workflows so analysts can move from
discovery to action faster.

### Accuracy

#### Reduce false positives and improve case solve rates.

Advanced correlation, enrichment, and link analysis to help investigators surface relevant OSINT
signals and eliminate noise. Make confident decisions with cleaner, more reliable intelligence.

### Flexibility

#### Built to support investigators at every stage.

From initial OSINT inquiries to large-scale, multi-case investigations, Horizon® is designed to
align with established investigative methodologies, enabling efficient collection, analysis,
collaboration, and decision-making through intuitive tools, automation, and advanced controls.

### Ethical OSINT intelligence, by design.

Ethical OSINT data collection is foundational to ShadowDragon. Our OSINT software platform is
purpose built to support lawful, responsible investigations without compromising privacy or trust.
[ Trust Center ][54]

#### Real-time OSINT data

Continuously monitor publicly available OSINT data to identify emerging threats, risks, and
connections as they happen, not retrospectively.

#### No mass scraping or hacking

OSINT data is accessed responsibly without invasive scraping, credential misuse, or exploitation,
ensuring investigations remain ethical and defensible.

#### Unattributed searches

Conduct OSINT investigations without exposing analyst identities or investigative intent, protecting
operational security throughout the process.

#### Compliant to regulations

Built to support compliant OSINT investigations, Horizon® OSINT software aligns with data protection
and investigative standards across jurisdictions and regulated environments.

#### SOC 2 Type II Certified

Our enterprise OSINT software meets rigorous security requirements, with independently audited
controls designed for government and enterprise investigations.

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

## Our Impact

Each year, we strive to transform lives and strengthen communities worldwide.
* ### 18 million community members served annually
  
  Across the U.S., our Ys reach millions of people in 10,000 communities.
* ### 2.4 million youths served in food programs
  
  We provide millions of pounds of groceries to families each month.
* ### 244,000 overnight camp participants
  
  Our day and overnight camps empowered kids by building lifelong skills, confidence and
  friendships.
* ### 2,597 Ys across the U.S.
  
  Ys reach millions of people across 50 states, plus the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico.
